summary: fetchAllWebsites paginates past 200 sites; snapshotMetrics writes each (day, metric_type) pair in one transaction so interrupted runs leave no frozen partial history.
reason: Greptile review findings P1/P2 on PR #1458: single-page site listing silently dropped sites beyond 200, and the existing-pair skip in snapshotMetrics treated partially written days as complete.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test green; live: portfolio returns all 18 sites, snapshot re-run stays idempotent with no partial rows.
